_comment: Human-reviewed expectations for fixtures/transcripts/energy-outlook-30min.srt (acceptance criterion B1: a 30-minute transcript). Statement date for this fixture is 2026-03-10. Windows: w1 0–720 s, w2 604–1330 s, w3 1210–1800 s. Used by pipeline-30min.test.ts with canned replies and by evals/ with real models.

mustExtract.quoteContains: Illinois regulators will approve at least two new gigawatt-scale
mustExtract.timeExpression: by the end of next year
mustExtract.note: Repeated verbatim at 1700 s — one prediction, two occurrences, never two rows.

mustExtract.quoteContains: Hashprice might recover to eighty dollars
mustExtract.note: Hedge must be preserved: 'might' never becomes 'will'.

mustExtract.quoteContains: moratorium on new crypto-mining interconnects above ten megawatts
mustExtract.note: Spans the w1/w2 window boundary at 720 s; must be stored once with the full quote located across both cues.

mustExtract.quoteContains: raise industrial rates by double digits
mustExtract.note: Compound: two future claims plus a causal link.
'Eventually' → deadline unknown; must not be invented.

mustExtract.quoteContains: exceed one thousand exahash before the next halving
mustExtract.note: Halving date not stated; app must not guess.

mustNotExtract.quoteContains: The governor said last week that he expects
energized the first forty megawatts in January
I don't know, and I'm not going to pretend I do
